instruction.text: Choose the fraction with the <t-yellow>numerator</t-yellow> and <t-purple>denominator</t-purple> in the correct place.

hint.text: Remember that the <t-yellow>numerator</t-yellow> is always on the top of a fraction and that the <t-purple>denominator</t-purple> is always on the bottom.

atoms.a: I ate one out of four apples in the bag.
He had two out of nine squares from the chocolate bar.
Four out of six people in my class hadn’t done their maths homework.
Two out of my three sisters have blonde hair.
Six of my classmates have siblings. There are ten of us in my class.
There were seven ducks in the pond. Six ate the bread they were fed.
